title: GreenGateway policy evidence request
description: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for a policy-evidence-request.v1 document: the inputs of one policy evidence package, which names exactly one candidate, a publication or a draft. The gateway's parser is authoritative and also enforces what this schema does not state: the suite is a complete policy-tests.v1 suite (see policy-tests.v1.schema.json) and every simulation case a policy-simulation.v1 case (see policy-simulation.v1.schema.json), with unique case ids; repeated member names are refused; and every limit is in bytes, not characters. Whether a named draft belongs to the caller, is still at draft_etag and is pinned to the live policy is the gateway's answer when the request is served. Unknown members are refused everywhere.

version.description: The policy history version the package is about.

etag.description: The policy ETag of the document the caller reviewed. A stored document with any other ETag is refused with 409.

draft.description: A server-side draft the caller owns, at the strong draft ETag the caller reviewed it at. The package is labelled candidate_kind draft and is never presented as a publication.

suite.description: A complete policy-tests.v1 suite, run against the candidate.

simulation.description: Synthetic cases decided under the candidate and what it replaces: the history version before a publication, the live policy a draft is pinned to.

replay_job_id.description: A finished replay job of the caller's whose candidate is the packaged document.

analysis.description: true to include the conservative structural analyzer's results over the candidate, with each finding's suppression state, as a manifest artifact. Omitted or false leaves the analysis out.
